description.value:
You experiment further on your companion. Whenever you create a Reanimated Companion, it now gains two Strange Modifications options instead of one, and you can also choose from the following options.

Bloated. The companion becomes Large. Whenever it hits a Large or smaller creature with Dreadful Swipe, that creature is pushed up to 10 feet away from it. You can also add your Intelligence modifier to the damage of its Death Burst.

Gaunt. The companion's Speed increases to 45 feet, and it gains a Climb Speed equal to its Speed; it can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check. Whenever a creature of your choice starts its turn in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the companion, that creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn.

Moist. The companion gains a Swim Speed equal to its Speed and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without extra movement. Whenever it is hit by an attack roll from a creature within 10 feet of it, the attacker takes Acid damage equal to your Intelligence modifier.
